title: A direct posts insert cannot forge a system line or hang a reply under a post the member cannot see

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), regression review of #3140 (SCAN-680, SCAN-682).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: SCAN-680 and SCAN-682 were closed in createPost and createReply only. The 'posts: insert (crew+ in scope)' policy never constrains post_type, so 'system', 'space_update' and 'announcement' are accepted and 'system' renders as an unattributed system line with no Report menu (components/feed/post-card.tsx), and it never checks parent_id against the parent's scope, so a public reply can sit under a cluster post the member cannot see. The SCAN-680 row itself says no migration restricts post_type on insert. THE FIX: add post_type in ('feed','note') to the WITH CHECK (announcements keep their admin path) and either parent_id is null (replies go through createReply) or a parent-visibility check.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!fs.readdirSync('supabase/migrations').some(f=>f>'20270317000000'&&/posts: insert/.test(r('supabase/migrations/'+f))&&/post_type\s+in\s*\(/.test(r('supabase/migrations/'+f)))){console.error('SCAN-846: the posts insert policy accepts any post_type and any parent');process.exit(1)}"
